conditional_cooperator

<DESCRIPTION>
Begin cooperatively to enable mutual-payoff outcomes against reciprocal opponents, then exploit opponents that have consistently cooperated. Against persistent defection, defect as well to avoid repeated zero payoffs.
</DESCRIPTION>

def policy(own_history, opponent_history):
    if len(opponent_history) == 0:
        return 0
    if opponent_history.count(1) == 0:
        return 1
    if opponent_history[-1] == 1:
        return 1
    return 0
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
